translation:
In the Name of Allah, the All-merciful, the
All-compassionate

original language:
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ
وَ آلِ مُحَمَّد
translation: O Allah bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

original language: اَسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَامُحَمَّدِ نِ الْحَسَنِ الْعَسْكَرِىِّ
translation:
Peace be upon you
O Abu Muhammad al-Hasan al-Askari

original language:
اَسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا 
الْبَرُّ الصَّادِقُ الْوَفِيُّ
translation: Peace be upon you O one who is righteous, truthful and loyal

original language: اَسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَلِيَّ اَمْرِ اللهِ
translation: Peace be with you O guardian of the affair of God

original language:
اَسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ 
يَا خَازِنَ عِلْمِ اللهِ
translation: Peace be with you O keeper of the knowledge of God

original language:
اَسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَابْنَ 
حُجَجِ اللهِ عَلَي بَرِيَّتِهِ
translation: Peace be with you O son of the proofs of God upon His creation

original language:
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ اَفْضَلَ 
مَا صلَّيْتَ
translation: O God bless him with the best of Your blessings as You have blessed …

original language:
عَلَي اَحَدٍ مِنْ اَصْفِيَائِكَ
وَ حُجَجِكَ وَ اَوْلِيَائِكَ
translation: … anyone from Your chosen ones, Your proofs, Your saints ...
... the progeny of Your Messengers and Your Prophets!
Ameen, O Lord of the worlds!
